scripts/check-links.ts.name: Check internal links
scripts/check-links.ts.description: Walks every doc, partial and glossary entry and fails on an internal link, include or #fragment that resolves to nothing.

scripts/check-nitro-release.ts.name: Nitro release check
scripts/check-nitro-release.ts.description: Reports the pinned versus latest Nitro release and verifies every pinned upstream path; --to <tag> is the only writer of the pins.

scripts/lib/announcement-link.ts.name: Banner link check
scripts/lib/announcement-link.ts.description: Validates the announcement banner href from vars.json against the docs index, a public/ file or an https URL.

scripts/lib/doc-anchors.ts.name: Fragment link check
scripts/lib/doc-anchors.ts.description: Compiles each page through the site's MDX preset and include pass to collect rendered ids, then flags #fragment links with no target.

scripts/lib/doc-links.ts.name: Docs link index
scripts/lib/doc-links.ts.description: Indexes every content doc, extracts links from markdown, JSX hrefs and includes, resolves them and applies byte-range rewrites.

scripts/lib/module-imports.ts.name: Client module imports
scripts/lib/module-imports.ts.description: Parses a module with Babel to recognise a 'use client' directive and list its runtime imports, for the client-boundary test.

scripts/lib/nitro-node-image.ts.name: Node image sync
scripts/lib/nitro-node-image.ts.description: Rewrites the hardcoded Nitro node image tag in every content file that opts in with a sync-with-var marker.

scripts/lib/nitro-upstream-paths.ts.name: Nitro path pins
scripts/lib/nitro-upstream-paths.ts.description: Collects the nitroPathTo* pins and every Nitro source link in content, and names the ones absent at the pinned tag.

scripts/references-check.ts.name: Glossary reference check
scripts/references-check.ts.description: Fails when a glossary entry lacks an id or repeats one, or when a partial holding a Term is ESM-imported instead of included.

scripts/vars-check.ts.name: Banner vars check
scripts/vars-check.ts.description: Fails when the announcement banner id is not a valid HTML id or its link points at nothing that exists.
